deloitte-tmt-predictions-2005-002.note: Wikipedia 'Direct-ethanol fuel cell' lists only prototypes (phone chargers, 2007 Offenburg Eco-marathon car), no commercial consumer product; Toshiba Dynario (2009) was methanol. No launch in 2005 or the 5-year window: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2005-004.note: Wikipedia 'Mobile malware' confirms Commwarrior-A (reported March 2005) spreading by MMS after Cabir (2004); Zotob and Sony BMG rootkit in 2005. Directional claim held in 2005: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2005-006.note: Nextgov (Feb 2006) shows operating mesh networks only in mid-size US cities (Corpus Christi, Ripon, Marshalltown) with Philadelphia, San Francisco etc. still planned and no Europe/Asia examples; event happened only partly and late across the three regions: partial.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2005-007.note: TV Technology (DisplaySearch, Q3 2005): LCD TV shipments 5.5M, +156% y/y; flat panels 55% of TV revenue, +87% y/y. Billions of USD and strong growth both met: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2006-001.note: Pew (Aug 2008): search 49% vs email 60% of internet users on a typical day (May 2008); Pew (Aug 2011): search 59% vs email 61% (May 2011). Search did not displace email by 2011: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2006-002.note: iTnews (Mar 2007) confirms IDC: 161 EB 'created and copied' in 2006, the only 2006 measure. Copies inflate the figure (method difference, D23), but 20 EB is 88% below; a miss unless unique data were under ~15% of IDC's total, which no source suggests: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2006-003.note: NSF SEI 2010 archive: $1.107T worldwide R&D in 2007; NCSES: $722B (2000) to $1.416T (2010) PPP at 7.0%/yr, implying about $1.03-1.08T in 2006. Above $1T and within 10% of the forecast: hit (2006 value interpolated, not published).

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2006-004.note: Wikipedia 'Universal Service Fund': June 2006 FCC voted to require VoIP providers to contribute to the USF the same way traditional telephone services did. Event in target year: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2006-005.note: Wikipedia 'Oracle Linux': released 26 Oct 2006, compiled from RHEL source, an incumbent restructuring its offer around open source. Vague directional claim, single reading, held: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2009-003.note: Grader figure (Wikipedia 'about 20% at peak') was not year-specific; DisplaySearch via HotHardware confirms 2009 mini-notes at 33.3M units, +103% y/y, 19.6% of portable PC shipments. Above the 15% floor and above ~25M units: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2009-005.note: Google efficiency page: fleet TTM PUE 1.19 in every quarter of 2009, best sites 1.11-1.13 (Data Centers E, F). Newest purpose-built centres at or below 1.2 in 2009: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2009-010.note: Apple newsroom (5 Jan 2010): over 3bn cumulative App Store downloads since mid-2008, so about 2.5bn in 2009 in the largest store; other stores were far smaller (grader's Gartner 2.5bn figure not fetched). Even several times smaller stores cannot reach 10bn: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2009-011.note: Wikipedia: Samsung M8910 Pixon12 available June 2009 with 12MP (4000x3000) camera and 720p video; Sony Ericsson Satio (12.1MP) on sale Oct 2009. Event in target year: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2010-008.note: Nielsen Q1 2010: 158h25m TV a month vs 3h10m online video; Nielsen Q3/Q4 2010 usage report: about 10.5h timeshifted a month at end-2010 (A's DVR figure was from memory, now confirmed), so live viewing was about 93% in the US: hit. The >80% audio sub-claim was not evidenced by either grader.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2010-010.note: Wikipedia 'E-reader' (IDC, Mar 2011): 12.8M e-readers sold worldwide in 2010. Forecast of 5M is 61% low: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-001.note: Wikipedia PC vendors page: 352.8M PCs shipped in 2011. Smartphone totals (Gartner 472M) were not fetched (403), but any 2011 smartphone count above ~300M plus tablets puts non-PCs above 50%, and Canalys reported smartphones outshipped PCs incl. pads: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-005.note: The claim is comparative ('more ... than ever before'); both graders cite only 2011 events (Wikipedia PSN breach, cookie directive) with no measure against 2010, itself a peak privacy year (Facebook settings, Street View Wi-Fi). Evidence does not support any verdict on the comparison.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-006.note: Wikipedia 'Electric vehicle battery': average battery costs fell 90% from 2010 to 2024 via chemistry and manufacturing advances; the cited source gives no 2011-2012 point, but the trivially weak claim ('progress') held: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-007.note: Wikipedia 'Fuel cell forklift': just over 4,000 in US use in 2013 and about 50,000 worldwide in 2024 vs 1.2M battery forklifts bought in 2021 alone; well under 5% within 5 years under either reading: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-008.note: Nielsen Q1 2010 (TV 158h25m/month, +2h y/y) and ZenithOptimedia (TV 40.2% of 2011 global adspend vs internet 16.0%, TV largest). TV kept its lead in 2011; vague claim, direction held: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-010.note: Nielsen Q1 2010 three-screen and Q3/Q4 2010 usage reports: about 10.5h timeshifted of about 158h TV a month at end-2010, online video about 3h; live viewing above 90%, the 'vast majority': hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-011.note: comScore (Dec 2011): social networking sites reached 1.2bn users (82% of online population 15+) in October 2011. Above 1bn: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-014.note: A's cited musicbusinessresearch 2014 page does not state the 2011 figures in text; HuffPost on the RIAA 2011 year-end report confirms digital slightly passed 50% of US shipment value, beating physical, and Wikipedia 'Music industry' says digital topped physical in the US by 2011: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2011-015.note: RCR Wireless (5 Jan 2012): GSA confirmed 49 operators had launched commercial LTE. 49 vs a ceiling of 30 is far outside 25%: miss. (B's '29 countries' figure was not confirmed but is not needed.)

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2012-004.note: Wikipedia 'Smartphone': 725M smartphones sold in 2012, all flash-based, plus flash-only tablets; HDD players were a residual line. Flash share above 90% on units or capacity is inferred, no tracker publishes it, but no plausible figure brings it below 90%: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2012-005.note: Wikipedia Energy harvesting: ambient RF harvesting gives very low power and is used in passive RFID and single sensor nodes; no mass-market product category. Claim of staying niche held: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2013-001.note: Cisco VNI release (June 2014) gives 33% of IP traffic from non-PC devices, but IP traffic includes managed IPTV/VoD to set-top boxes; the claim is about Internet traffic. The release has no Internet-only device split, and removing managed video plausibly puts the PC share near 80%, so the miss rests on an unconfirmed figure.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2013-007.note: Wikipedia 4K resolution: CEA Ultra HD definition Oct 2012, consumer UHD sets widely available in 2013, YouTube 2160p Dec 2013. Rollout commenced in 2013: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2016-009.note: Box Office Mojo: 2016 domestic total $11.374B. $10.6B is 6.8% below: hit under the D16 numeric rule (direction of change was wrong, the level was not).

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2016-012.note: PocketGamer.biz reporting Newzoo 2017 report: 2016 global esports revenue $493M; $500M is 1.4% off: hit. SuperData's higher figure uses a broader scope (other quantity), so the D23 median rule does not apply.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2016-016.note: GSA status update 31 Jan 2017: 102 operators had commercially launched VoLTE in 54 countries; ~100 is within 2%: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2019-001.note: GSA 5G market snapshot Jan 2020: 61 operators in 34 countries had launched 3GPP 5G services by end-2019 (49 mobile). 25 is 59% below (or 49% below the mobile-only count): miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2020-002.note: IFR press release: professional service robot turnover $6.7B in 2020 (+12%). IFR changed method from World Robotics 2020 ($11.2B for 2019), but even the old series grown 12% (~$12.5B) leaves $16B more than 25% high: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2020-003.note: GSA Dec 2020 update counts 259 companies deploying LTE or 5G (500+ incl. trials) with no 5G split; GSA's Aug 2021 release (Grader B's '120+ 5G projects') post-dates the target and says LTE was in 81% of networks in Oct 2020, implying well under 100 catalogued 5G at end-2020. No source confirms >100 companies testing 5G by end-2020.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2020-004.note: McDowell Starlink stats: about 960 Starlink satellites launched through end-2020 (most in orbit) plus about 110 OneWeb: well over 700 broadband LEO satellites: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2021-002.note: Synergy: total public cloud revenue +21% and IaaS/PaaS +29% in 2022; Amazon Q4 2023 release: AWS +13% in 2023. Growth fell below 30% in 2022-2023, so 'above 30% every year 2021-2025' failed: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2021-003.note: WHO Q&A on 5G: no adverse health effect causally linked to wireless exposure; none established for 2021: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2022-005.note: SemiMedia citing Susquehanna: average chip lead time about 24 weeks in Dec 2022 (peak 27 in May 2022). 20% above the 20-week upper bound: partial.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2022-013.note: Estimates of end-2022 floating PV conflict: REN21 GSR 2024 'at least 5.6 GW operational' (5.2 is 7% below, a hit), REN21 GSR 2023 'well over 3 GW', Wikipedia/Bloomberg 13 GW (miss). Spread exceeds 2x (D23), so the agreed miss is not supported.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2022-014.note: National Literacy Trust 2023: 24.9% of boys vs 30.4% of girls read daily; enjoyment 40.5% vs 45.3%. Gap persists, consistent with long-running cross-country data: hit (evidence covers few countries).

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2022-018.note: Wikipedia Quantum volume: Quantinuum 2^11 (Dec 2021) to 2^13 (Sep 2022); IBM 2^7 (best through 2021) to 2^9 (May 2022). Two makers at least doubled: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2022-019.note: Wikipedia AI Act: Council general approach Dec 2022, agreement Dec 2023, in force Aug 2024; US AI Bill of Rights blueprint Oct 2022. Proposals in 2022, enforcement 2023+: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2023-001.note: McDowell Starlink stats: about 5,600 Starlink launched by end-2023, over 5,000 in orbit, plus ~630 OneWeb; two working constellations, Starlink 2.3M subscribers (Wikipedia): hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2023-002.note: Graders' 2023 price evidence (itel P55 5G at Rs 9,699, ~US$116) returned 404; only Lava Blaze 5G (Oct 2022, ~US$125) and Poco C75 5G (Dec 2024, Rs 7,399 per Cashify) were confirmed. A 2023 phone within 10% of US$99 (with offers) would make it a hit, so partial rests on an unconfirmed figure.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2023-003.note: GSA press release: 115 operators investing in public 5G SA as of July 2023 (121 by Oct 2023 per graders). Far below 200, more than 25% short: miss.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2024-012.note: Wikipedia Fallout (TV series): Amazon/Bethesda adaptation premiered Apr 2024 with large audiences; other 2024 game adaptations. Stated trend held: hit (claim is a weak trend statement).

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2024-014.note: Roblox 10-K: developer exchange fees $922.8M in 2024; Epic reported $352M paid to Fortnite creators in 2024 (TechSpot, GamesBeat $342M). Total ~$1.27B; 1.5 is ~18% high: partial.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2025-002.note: IEA Energy and AI: data centres ~415 TWh, ~1.5% of global electricity in 2024, ~12-15%/yr growth, so ~1.6-1.7% in 2025; within 0.5 pt of 2% under D18: hit (D16 relative rule would give partial).

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2025-010.note: Wikipedia VodafoneThree: CMA approval with binding conditions Dec 2024, merger completed June 2025; T-Mobile/UScellular also closed in 2025. Consolidation advanced under regulator conditions: hit.

deloitte-tmt-predictions-2025-014.note: GSA 5G SA key data: 95 operators launched by Apr 2026, +42% since 1Q25 (~67), only one 2026 launch, so ~27 launches in Q2-Q4 2025 alone; SA share 26-29%, not ~12%. More than 25% above 20: miss.
